purpose: Bounded native Paperclip artifact smoke verification. Tests only the create-readback surfaces that MEM054/MEM058 explicitly permit: native issue, document, and comment create-readback. ALL OTHER plugin/UI/data/action/tool/state/activity/events/Hermes/GSD-Pi surfaces remain blocked or unvalidated regardless of this artifact's verdict. Verdict this turn: BLOCKED_NO_LIVE_API — no authenticated HTTP API access was available in auto-mode (LFP-S02-01, LFP-LF-03), so bounded_native_smoke_attempted is false and no native surface was exercised.
verdict_classification_rationale: T04 native-smoke verdict is the deterministic function f(t02_contract_present, t03_deploy_present, fresh_readback_performed, session_cookie_available, bounded_native_smoke_attempted) → BLOCKED_NO_LIVE_API. With t03_deploy_present=false (no upgrade actually deployed) and fresh_readback_performed=false (no authenticated readback possible in auto-mode per LFP-S02-01), there is no live API endpoint to issue against. bounded_native_smoke_attempted is therefore false by construction. Per MEM049 ('blocker/fallback artifacts can be valid diagnostics during live phase, but final phase requires live-evidence with issue, document, and comment readback hashes'), promoting to PASS would require actual create-readback hashes — which were not produced. Per MEM139 (no-promotion ledger), this artifact records the BLOCKED verdict honestly without false PASS claims.
